I got this as a sample and just bought a whole jar, it made my skin so soft and hydrated. These products are so great for sensitive skin.

I love this stuff. It might be a little bit pricey, but I cut the pads in half. My skin looks and feels better. There's a nice tingly feeling, and a glow that lasts a couple of days. It's a nice extra treat for my 71-year-old skin. Highly recommend.

Nice! Love the 2 sided different textures on the pad and generous liquid in the jar.

I unfortunately have incredibly sensitive skin that is often very red and dry due to rosacea. I have to be very careful about what I use on my face. I'd been trying to find an exfoliant that would remove dry skin but not irritate my skin for quite some time and decided to take a change on the bio-peel. I'm so glad I did! I've been using this product for about a month now and my skin look and feels so good! I use them no more than once a week and although my skin gets pink after use, by the morning its gone. The green tea scent is really lovely (I'm picky about scents) and smells so refreshing. If you have sensitive skin I 100% recommend these.

I can't believe how long it took for me to try this out. I'm a huge fan of anything green tea so I had to choose this over the Wine and Lemon versions. I have no regrets.I have extremely sensitive skin, but the gauze was gentle enough to not irritate. I use it a couple of times a week and absolutely love the way my skin feels and looks after every use.

My skin was visibly clear and 200% smoother after using just one pad. Results are instantaneous. There are 30 pads in each tub, I've also tried it on my dad and my brother. Both had visibly smoother skin right after. It smells like greentea and is easy to work with.

This is one of my absolute favorite beauty products of all time. My skin is extremely sensitive, and plagued by dermatitis and redness that requires constant maintenance. The scent of this product is very mild, and green tea is an excellent antioxidant that's effective at minimizing redness and irritation. Each pad has a handy pouch for your fingers. First you gently exfoliate using the coarse side, and then you flip the pad over the smooth your skin out with the other side. Afterwards, you can either splash water on your face a few times and continue your routine, or gently rest a warm washcloth on your face for a few minutes to absorb the green tea goodness. Every Neogen product I've tried has been wonderful, and I truly wish they would cook up a green tea moisturizer or serum.
I was looking for a gentle chemical like exfoliation once a week, and this is perfect! Its super gentle and smells relaxing. I wake up with softer clearer skin the next day.

I love using the pads, I saw them from Joanday on YouTube & wanted to try it out. The smell is great & my skin feels amazing afterwards. Great addition to my skin routine, at this time I use only 3xs a wk.
Love these. I have oily skin & tend to get bumps and texture on my cheeks. Perfect for gently exfoliating without irritating my skin.

I ordered these and the red wine ones at the same time since my skin is tricky and I need different effects depending on my skin's condition when I use them. What's noticable first is the scent, a very mild and pleasing fragrance. Used twice a week, I could see a visibly even skin brightness, and my dry combination skin loves the exfoliation + moisture. Can't recommend these enough. I feel like they help my hyperpigmentation but that could also be the Vitamin C serum
It you have sensitive, it could be a little too harsh on the skin, but I love that it has two side. One is soft and smooth while the other side is more for exfoliating and sort of rough on the skin.

This product is so easy to use, and so effective! The Green tea smells fantastic and isn't harsh on my skin, making it easy for me to use daily. The dual sides of the pad are lovely, one is more of a gauze texture and scrubs skin well, the other side is a cotton pad which feels nice and soft on the skin!
I love Neogen products so much. It always treats my skin gently and minimizes my breakout. 100% recommended!
Could see my dead skin flakes on the pad. Smells amazing and perfect for exfoliation.

Great to use to exfoliate skin and to reduce acne scars and black/white heads.

I have dry, sensitive, dehydrated skin with aging concerns. I fell in love with this product and will never be without it, ever. This is the most soothing and refreshing exfoliation product I've ever used. It's not harsh but it's definitely effective. I can't say enough about Green Tea Bio-Peel. I just turned 49 and my skin was getting that rough and wrinkly texture. I tried other exfoliating products but they were harsh and took a long time for my sensitive skin to heal. Tried this one and first thing I noticed was no burning, then how soft my skin felt. After 7 uses the texture of my skin is so soft and smooth. There's definitely an improvement. After using this on my face in the shower I use the pads on my arms and knees and anywhere I think I need extra help that week. This is just awesome. Going to try the Micro Essence and Serum next. Thanks for making such a life changing product.
